title: A hideout, and nobody home
description: A cave mouth behind a fallen oak, ash still warm in the pit. They left in a hurry. A rope trips the dark past the first bend, and beyond it something glints.

choices.text: Step over the tripline and search the back.

onPass.narration: The rope is tied to a hanging log, and the log stays hung. Behind a false wall of brush: a strongbox, unlocked, because who robs a robber.

onFail.narration: The log comes down out of the dark and catches the first one in with a sound you feel in your own ribs. The strongbox is there. It was not free.

choices.text: Burn the place so they don't come back.

onPass.narration: The brush catches fast. Whatever they hid in there is gone with it, and so is the hideout.

choices.text: Not worth a rope in the dark.

onPass.narration: You mark the oak and keep to the road.
